d:
The Challa story continues Challa 2 is the new track from Sabba’s album Proud. Sabba wrote, composed and sang it, with music by Meavin and presentation by Meeru.
It’s a soulful Punjabi track with Sabba’s signature heartfelt touch, one to play on repeat
Song Credits
Song :- Challa 2
Singer Lyrics & Composer - Sabba
Music :- Meavin
Album :- Proud
Presentation - Meeru
